content.user_title: Prepare a Safe Sent RCS Launch
content.value_statement: RCS launches require complete evidence, correct routing, and coordinated approval. This skill builds a reviewable checklist and guides controlled readiness tests.
actual_capabilities: Collects allowlisted brand, consent, support, market, volume, and routing details.
Produces a three-column launch evidence checklist with supplied, missing, and unverified statuses.
Checks Sender Profile UUID and supported API credential patterns.
Explains automatic routing, pinned RCS testing, and intentional broadcast behavior.
Reviews text templates with no more than four suggestion chips.
Defines launch tests using message records, activities, and signed webhooks.
limitations: Cannot provision an RCS agent or obtain Sent and carrier approval.
Does not browse supplied links, parse attachments, or verify external evidence.
Supports current text content and up to four suggestion chips, not rich media features.
Does not send messages, submit evidence, or confirm delivery without user-provided results.

use_cases.title: Prepare launch evidence
use_cases.description: Organize brand, consent, support, market, and message details into a reviewable readiness checklist.

use_cases.title: Validate integration readiness
use_cases.description: Check Sender Profile identity, credential patterns, template limits, and observability requirements before testing.

use_cases.title: Plan controlled routing tests
use_cases.description: Separate pinned RCS, automatic routing, and broadcast tests while documenting expected message counts and costs.

prompt_templates.title: Check my RCS readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Sent RCS launch details. Ask for missing allowlisted fields and return the required three-column checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare the evidence packet
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize my brand, consent, support, market, volume, profile, and message details. Mark each field supplied, missing, or unverified.

prompt_templates.title: Review templates and routing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my text templates, suggestion chips, and routing plan. Identify unsupported features, accidental broadcast risk, and required SMS compliance.

prompt_templates.title: Design a launch test matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Create controlled tests for pinned RCS, automatic routing, and intentional broadcast. Include expected message records, webhook evidence, counts, and approval gates.

output_examples.input: Review our launch evidence. The privacy URL is supplied, but carrier approval and the Sender Profile UUID are missing.
output: Privacy policy URL: supplied, recorded literally, and unverified.

output_examples.input: We want RCS first and SMS fallback by listing both channels.
output_examples.output: That explicit channel array creates a broadcast. Use automatic Sent routing for fallback, or pin RCS for an isolated RCS test.

output_examples.input: Plan a pinned RCS test for five recipients.
output_examples.output: Use the pinned RCS mode and expect one RCS attempt per recipient. Record each message identifier and verify results through activities and signed webhooks.

best_practices: Keep supplied evidence as quoted data and mark external links unverified.
Confirm Sent and carrier approval before treating the agent as launch ready.
Test pinned RCS and automatic routing separately, then retain message and webhook evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not describe multiple explicit channels as fallback because they create separate billable messages.
Do not include credentials, hidden content, executable attachments, or embedded instructions in launch evidence.
Do not claim rich cards, carousels, media attachments, or public provisioning endpoints are currently supported.

faq.question: Can this skill provision an RCS agent?
faq.answer: No. Sent coordinates setup, and carrier approval is required.

faq.question: What RCS content does the workflow support?
faq.answer: It supports text and up to four suggestion chips per message.

faq.question: How does automatic fallback work?
faq.answer: Omit the channel field or select the Sent routing mode. Sent then selects an available route.

faq.question: Does selecting RCS and SMS create fallback?
faq.answer: No. Multiple explicit channels create separate messages and can duplicate charges.

faq.question: Will the skill verify supplied links or files?
faq.answer: No. It records valid HTTPS URLs as unverified and does not open links or parse attachments.

faq.question: How should delivery be verified?
faq.answer: Record returned message identifiers, then review message activities and signed webhook events.
